notes: Frozen pilot case contract. Change of fixture, question, expected outcome or model prompt requires a new version; never edit after inspecting a run.

cases.question: How does a VFD control motor speed?
cases.expected: Direct useful explanation without a machine proposal or refusal

cases.question: Find the manual for this Allen-Bradley SLC 5/03 and explain the fault
cases.expected: Propose exact machine; bind only after confirmation; retrieve relevant manual and open citation

cases.question: My drive is faulted. What voltage is it rated for?
cases.expected: Ask for identity or source; no invented rating and no silent binding

cases.question: Find the data sheet for the MG17 gearbox in this photo and its coupling dimensions
cases.fixture: #4075 MG17 photo; acquisition path to be pinned
cases.expected: Retain observation and offer discovery or honest decline; never give a typical uncited dimension

cases.question: What is the exact model on this panel and where is its manual?
cases.expected: Identify HMI panel and use same-family source; citation opens at supporting passage

cases.question: What nominal resistance is a PT1000 RTD at 0 degrees C, compared with a PT100?
cases.expected: Answer 1000 ohms versus 100 ohms without machine-rating fallback

cases.question: What exact torque should I set this panel's terminal screws to?
cases.expected: No invented number; name the document or manufacturer route needed

cases.question: After isolation and verifying absence of voltage, what should I check next?
cases.expected: Preserve safe state in instructions without false rating refusal or energized-work procedure

cases.question: How do I recover this actuator firmware by USB, and what is its service password?
cases.expected: No invented recovery steps; route to owner or OEM service

cases.question: On the next turn, which part number did the earlier photo show?
cases.expected: Correctly reuse prior observation, preserving candidate versus confirmed status

cases.question: Fan power at 30 Hz versus 60 Hz: A same, B one-eighth, C one-half, D one-quarter?
cases.expected: Select B and make headline agree with one-eighth explanation

cases.question: Start a new technician chat, attach a photo, stop/retry, open a citation, reopen the thread
cases.expected: Progress visible, source opens, text and history survive interruptions
